audience: customer support teams that answer WhatsApp chats in UnderChat

useCases.title: See which chats wait in the queue
useCases.text: List the chats in the queue, or the chats assigned to you. Count the unread messages with the unread summary.

useCases.title: Read the history of a customer chat
useCases.text: Search the chats by contact name or phone. Read the messages of a chat, or search one chat for a word.

useCases.title: Answer a customer on WhatsApp
useCases.text: Send a text message into an existing chat, as the active user. The customer receives it on WhatsApp.

useCases.title: Hand a chat to a sector and label it
useCases.text: Transfer a chat to another channel, user or sector. Then set the labels and check the chat, because the API does not say whether labels are replaced or added.

useCases.title: Create a contact for a new lead
useCases.text: Check the contact by phone first, to see whether the number already exists. Then create the contact with a name and a phone number.
